decisions.decision: All agreed that no one will contact any consultants or do summaries without the agreement of the Commission.
decisions.quote: all agreed that no one will contact any consultants or do summaries without the agreement of the commission.

decisions.decision: All Commissioners, Heather and Jack agreed to attend a workshop meeting to discuss a policy on communications.
decisions.quote: all commissioners, heather and jack agreed to attend a workshop meeting to discuss a policy.

decisions.decision: Protocol for Commissioners addressing staff, departments, employees and vendors will be discussed at the workshop.
decisions.quote: all agreed that this would be discussed at the workshop.

decisions.decision: Anyone may get clarification from town counsel on protocol and procedure at the attorney office hours, but policy issues should not be discussed there.
decisions.quote: agreed that anyone should be able to get clarification from counsel on protocol and procedure but should not be discussing policy issues.

decisions.decision: Jack will send the Tasks I & II report electronically to Commissioners so all can review it before a list of questions is prepared.
decisions.quote: jack will send report electronically to commissioners to give all a chance to digest it

decisions.decision: Jack will get the Weston & Sampson-DEP report to the Sewer Commission once finished.
decisions.quote: weston & sampson-dep report, - jack spoke to pat today-should be finished this week and will get it to the sewer commission.

decisions.decision: Commission signed off on the Q2 commitment.
decisions.quote: q2 commitment - sewer commission signed off on commitment for $209,239.10.

decisions.decision: The 10/31/17 minutes were tabled to the next meeting, with Barb to make Troy's edit and resend them.
decisions.quote: minutes - 10/31/17 - tabled to next meeting and barb will make troy's edit and resend out.

decisions.decision: All agreed Barb should contact the attorney if she has not heard back on Crossroads; Crossroads will be on the next agenda and there will be no hearing on Dec. 5.
decisions.quote: barb said that they would not be having a hearing on dec. 5 and crossroads will be on the next agenda.

decisions.decision: All agreed that if Barb has not heard by the end of the week, she can start the non-compliance process for the October 1st Tuesday report.
decisions.quote: all agreed that if barb has not heard by the end of the week, she can start non-compliance process.

decisions.decision: Commission agreed the Millette extension is not a paving moratorium issue; the Commission decides on expansion.
decisions.quote: jack said that the paving moratorium should not be issue for sewer commission - the commission decides on expansion.

decisions.decision: Commission discussed doing a capital plan for future budget items based on a pump station survey.
decisions.quote: commission discussed doing a capital plan for future budget items, based on doing a pump station survey.
